description: This file implements core workflow execution logic for an approval management system, including starting workflows, progressing to next steps, and applying approvals or rejections. It interacts with database models and performs asynchronous operations to manage workflow state transitions.

methods.name: None start_workflow(db: AsyncSession, instance_id: int)
methods.description: Initializes and starts a new workflow instance by setting the first approval steps to IN_PROGRESS and updating the instance status.

methods.name: None proceed_to_next_step(db: AsyncSession, instance_id: int)
methods.description: Advances the workflow to the next step(s), handling sequential and parallel step types, and marks the workflow as completed if all steps are approved or finished.

methods.name: None apply_approval( db: AsyncSession, instance_step_id: int, approver_action: str, variables: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, comments: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Records an approval or rejection action on a given workflow step, updates its status, and triggers progression to subsequent steps based on business rules.
